默认英文。更改后同步到编辑器和菜单栏，不会翻译文章内容。: English by default. Changes apply to the editor and menu bar, without translating your articles.
请在系统设置中允许登录项。: Allow the login item in System Settings.
连接任意 Hexo 博客，或创建一个新的博客。: Connect an existing Hexo blog or create a new one.
目录需包含 _config.yml 和 package.json。切换项目会重新: Choose a folder containing _config.yml and package.json. Switching blogs reconnects the editor.
保留文章版本和整站快照，跳过相同内容。: Keep article versions and site snapshots. Identical content is backed up once.
可选择 OneDrive 的本地同步目录；云端上传由 OneDrive 客户端完: Choose a local OneDrive folder if desired. The OneDrive client handles cloud uploads.
定时备份仅在应用运行时执行。文章保存前始终建立版本备份。: Scheduled backups run while the app is open. Article versions are backed up before every save.
菜单栏名称、月相图标与位置来源。: Choose the menu bar name, icon, and location source.
系统时区估算（默认，无弹窗、不联网）: System time zone (default, offline, no permission prompt)
IP 城市定位（无弹窗，需要联网）: IP city lookup (online, no permission prompt)
时区位置是代表城市，并非当前位置。月相白天也显示；位置仅调整朝向。: The time zone provides a representative city, not your actual location. Moon phases display in daylight too; location only adjusts orientation.
IP 模式会访问 ipapi.co，让服务商看到出口 IP；不发送文章或 GPS: IP mode contacts ipapi.co, which sees your public IP. No articles or GPS coordinates are sent. A VPN may affect accuracy.
修改所连接博客的 Hexo 网站信息。: Edit the connected blog’s Hexo website information.
统一管理文章使用的标签、分类和关键词。: Manage the tags, categories, and keywords used across your articles.
重命名和移除会更新已保存文章，并先备份受影响版本。日期归档由文章日期生成。: Renaming or removing updates saved articles after backing up affected versions. Date archives follow article dates.
将生成的网站发布到自己的 GitHub 仓库。: Publish the generated website to your GitHub repository.
推送的是生成的网站，而不是 Hexo 源码。登录请在终端运行 gh auth l: This publishes the generated website, not Hexo source. To sign in, run gh auth login in Terminal.
独立的 Hexo 写作、备份与发布工具。: An independent Hexo writing, backup, and publishing tool.
左键：文章编辑器、本地服务、备份与目录。: Left click: editor, local server, backups, and folders.
右键：设置、关于和退出。: Right click: settings, about, and quit.
请从菜单栏打开设置窗口。: Open Settings from the menu bar app.
操作超时，请重试。: The operation timed out. Please try again.
请先在设置中连接博客: Connect a blog in Settings first.
仓库已创建。请保存发布设置。: Repository created. Save your publishing settings to use it.
这会更新所有引用此项的已保存文章。: This updates every saved article that uses this name.
后台任务正在进行，请稍后再试。: A background task is running. Please try again later.
后台任务正在进行，请稍后再退出。: A background task is running. Please quit after it finishes.
请填写有效的纬度和经度: Enter valid latitude and longitude values.
编辑器项目不匹配。: The editor is connected to a different blog.
编辑器未能启动。请检查日志和 4510 端口。: The editor could not start. Check the log and port 4510.
请选择包含 _config.yml 和 package.json 的 Hexo: Choose a Hexo folder containing _config.yml and package.json.
创建后会自动安装依赖并验证首页，需要网络连接。: Dependencies will be installed and the homepage verified. An internet connection is required.
请填写有效的博客文件夹名称。: Enter a valid blog folder name.
目标目录已经存在，请换一个文件夹名称。: That folder already exists. Choose a different name.
博客已创建并选中。打开文章编辑器，点击「网站设置」即可设置 GitHub 仓库。: Blog created and connected. Open Settings to configure your GitHub repository.
请检查网络后重试。: Check your connection and try again.
正在查询 IP 位置；暂用系统时区估算: Looking up IP location; using the time zone for now
IP 为近似位置，VPN／代理可能影响结果: IP location is approximate; VPNs and proxies may affect it
IP 定位不可用，已回退系统时区估算: IP lookup unavailable; using the time zone estimate
按当前时间计算，白天及地平线下也显示: Calculated for the current time, including daylight and below the horizon
选择一篇文章，或新建一篇: Choose an article or create a new one
文章属性 · 标题、标签、分类与关键词: Article Properties · Titles, Tags, Categories & Keywords
图片支持粘贴、拖入；格式会随文章保存: Paste or drop images; formatting is saved with the article
在这里编辑 Markdown 和顶部配置。: Edit Markdown and front matter here.
英文标题、中文标题和文件名，填写任意一项即可。: Fill in any one of the English title, Chinese title, or filename fields.
留空自动生成，中文标题使用拼音和下划线: Leave blank to generate; Chinese titles use pinyin and underscores
已连接 · 保存时自动备份: Connected · Versions are backed up on save
请等待图片上传或保存完成。: Wait for the image upload or save to finish.
有尚未保存的修改，确定离开这篇文章吗？: This article has unsaved changes. Leave it anyway?
请先打开或新建文章。: Open or create an article first.
请等待当前操作完成。: Wait for the current operation to finish.
图片超过 10 MB，请先缩小。: The image exceeds 10 MB. Resize it first.
查询发布状态失败，可刷新后重试。: Could not check publishing status. Refresh to try again.
这会将当前草稿转为文章，并生成、推送整个博客到 GitHub。: This converts the draft into a post, builds the entire blog, and pushes it to GitHub.
这会生成并推送整个博客，包含其他已保存的文章和主题修改。: This builds and pushes the entire blog, including other saved articles and theme changes.
发布前会保存当前文章，并将文章版本备份到配置的备份目录。继续发布吗？: The current article will be saved and versioned before publishing. Continue?
保存期间有新修改，请再次点击发布。: New edits were made during saving. Click Publish again.
已有相同版本，跳过重复备份: Identical version found; duplicate backup skipped
无法打开富文本，请检查 Markdown 顶部配置。: Cannot open rich text. Check the Markdown front matter.
表格尺寸：正文行数 × 列数（另含一行表头）: Table size: body rows × columns (plus one header row)
请输入有效的 http 或 https 链接。: Enter a valid http or https URL.
将使用手动填写的文件名: The entered filename will be used
文件名已存在，请修改文件名。: This filename already exists. Choose another.
文章配置已改变，请重新编辑属性。: Article metadata changed. Edit its properties again.
嵌入内容 · 可在 MD 编辑器中修改: Embedded content · edit in Markdown mode
张图片，请保存文章。: images. Save the article to keep the references.
请先在终端运行 gh auth login 登录 GitHub。: Run gh auth login in Terminal to sign in to GitHub.
文章需要 YAML 顶部配置。: The article needs YAML front matter.
文章标题不能为空。: The article title cannot be empty.
网站名称不能为空。: The website name cannot be empty.
请输入 GitHub 仓库地址或 owner/repository。: Enter a GitHub repository URL or owner/repository.
网站地址需要使用 http 或 https。: The website URL must use http or https.
配置已被其他程序修改，请重新加载。: The configuration changed in another app. Reload it first.
Hexo 配置文件存在 YAML 错误。: The Hexo configuration contains YAML errors.
发布中，请稍后修改设置。: Publishing is in progress. Change settings after it finishes.
文件已被其他工具修改。请先复制当前内容，再重新打开文章核对。: The file changed in another tool. Copy your current text, then reopen the article to compare.
版本备份失败，文章尚未保存。: Version backup failed. The article was not saved.
已有发布任务正在运行。: A publication is already in progress.
会话失效，请刷新编辑器。: The session expired. Refresh the editor.
操作失败，请检查目录权限。: The operation failed. Check folder permissions.
请选择博客目录以外的备份位置。: Choose a backup location outside the blog folder.
找不到 Hexo 配置或文章目录。: The Hexo configuration or article folder was not found.
备份期间博客内容发生变化，请稍后重试。: Blog content changed during backup. Please try again later.
找不到 Hexo。请先在博客目录安装 npm 依赖。: Hexo was not found. Install npm dependencies in the blog folder first.
Hexo 启动失败 · 查看日志: Hexo failed to start · View log
已保存 · 已有相同版本，跳过重复备份: Saved · Identical version found; duplicate backup skipped
文件路径超出目录。: The file path is outside the allowed folder.
请选择文章或草稿 Markdown 文件。: Choose an article or draft Markdown file.
文章需要以 YAML 配置区开头。: The article must begin with YAML front matter.
文章顶部 YAML 格式有误，请检查缩进和引号。: Invalid YAML front matter. Check indentation and quotes.
文件太大，请选择小于 10 MB 的图片或 2 MB 的文章。: The file is too large. Images must be under 10 MB and articles under 2 MB.
支持 PNG、JPEG、GIF 和 WebP 图片。: Supported formats: PNG, JPEG, GIF, and WebP.
文章目录已有同名文件，请先更换草稿文件名。: A post with this filename already exists. Rename the draft first.
已推送 GitHub，但 Pages 配置失败：: Pushed to GitHub, but Pages configuration failed:
网站内容相同，已跳过重复推送。: Site content is unchanged; duplicate push skipped.
网站部署后即可访问。: The site will be available after deployment.
发布中，请稍后保存。: Publishing is in progress. Save after it finishes.
原文件已被移动或删除，请重新打开文章。: The original file was moved or deleted. Reopen the article.
保存前请在 MD 编辑器中修正顶部配置。: Fix the front matter in Markdown mode before saving.
默认英文。选择后立即生效并自动保存，同步到编辑器和菜单栏，不会翻译文章内容。: English by default. Choosing a language applies and saves it immediately across the editor and menu bar, without translating article content.
语言和启动方式。修改后自动生效。: Language and startup preferences. Changes apply automatically.
请完成有效输入，随后会自动保存。: Complete the required fields; valid changes are saved automatically.
